title: On public and private binary classification with metric space valued predictors
summary: We consider the problem of binary classification in a framework where the predictor $X$ takes values in an arbitrary separable metric space $\mathcal X$ and the label $Y$ values in $\{ \pm 1 \}$. In the first part of this work, we assume that one has direct access to an i.i.d. sample $(X_1,Y_1),\ldots,(X_n,Y_n)$ from the unknown distribution of the pair $(X,Y)$. We derive a convergence rate for the Proto-NN classifier which was recently introduced as a classifier in the presence of metric space-valued predictors.
